status: POST-OUTCOME REVISION on 2026-09-07. Exploratory reanalysis of immutable v1 logs; not advance prespecification and not a simulation-runner configuration.
seeding: Same randomly chosen known-positive document for every method in a topic/seed pair; seed counts as one review; discovery/search cost excluded.
topic_selection: Selected before any model runs for legal/judicial, performance, insolvency/liquidity, ownership changes and crime/law enforcement; no selection based on model results.
temporary_negatives: 100 random unreviewed documents, resampled each fit, never persisted as true labels
inference: Descriptive within-collection results. No significance or superiority claim across legal matters or IST leads.
stopping: Fixed 5000-document budget, independent of hidden labels. Unreached recall thresholds remain censored.

extensions.explore_10: Use 10% random exploration for batches of at least 10

revision.reason: Fixed recall@1000 has topic-dependent mathematical ceilings and different prevalence-scaled review effort.
revision.phase: Phase 1 only; awaiting user review before Phase 2

analysis.interval_material_disagreement: different inclusion of zero or endpoint shift >= 25% of percentile width; post-outcome diagnostic, not a validated threshold
analysis.paired_unit: topic; average all seeds within topic first
analysis.wilcoxon: exact signed-rank sign enumeration; zeros omitted; average ranks for ties
analysis.contrasts: all unordered method pairs; unadjusted exploratory tests, not confirmatory discoveries

censoring.partial_recall_mean: label coverage and name excluded topics

deferred_phase_3_exit_criteria.prerequisite: instrumentation passes its exact replay test
deferred_phase_3_exit_criteria.required_run: Deferred Phase 3B combined census and schedule sweep, all five topics at budget=N with new streams; first report per-policy model-fit count and wall-clock estimate and wait for user approval
deferred_phase_3_exit_criteria.generation: distinct from immutable v1 results; preserve provenance
deferred_phase_3_exit_criteria.prohibited_now: Do not invoke experiment.py in Phase 1 or Phase 2

withdrawn_exploration_option: No pool/tail option in Phase 2: identical residual set under exploit-first. Distinct global exploration-before-exploitation arm deferred.
